scope: fixed saved controls and fixed analytical initial controls; no reoptimization
half_width: B and omega: 5% of nominal; theta and phi: 0.05 rad
joint_offsets: all sign combinations of the full half-widths
evaluation: midpoint propagation with exact derivatives at the true parameter; waveform and POVM fixed
numerical_rule: two successive changes in both C and Frobenius norm of F below 1e-4; substeps up to 256
